profile.headline: Software Engineer at Google
profile.summary: Experienced software developer with a demonstrated history of working in the internet industry. Skilled in Python, Javascript, SASS, SQL, and Linux.

positions.title: Software Engineer / System Administrator / Co-owner
positions.description: Communicated with prospective clients and wrote project proposals. Wrote specifications based on qualitative user and client research processes to fit within a specific budget. Managed client expectations around timelines and deliverables. Worked with team to come to a consensus around decisions related to specific projects and the business as a whole. Developed software related to accountant continuing education regulations in the United States. Developed API-powered React front-ends. Managed server deployments on a variety of linux flavors and hosting environments.

positions.title: Developer, Miro Community
positions.description: Developed an open-source video aggregation platform that made use of asynchronous web scraping scripts. Used Puppet and SaltStack to manage system configuration. Coordinated with team members, project managers, and clients.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Custom development on PhiloCMS (philocms.org), which was used to build Oberlin OnCampus (oncampus.oberlin.edu).

projects.title: django-daguerre
projects.description: Automated image cropping and resizing based on prioritized areas.
